snippet.title: [SMBX] TLoD - Super Mario 40th Anniversary Level Mash-Up Trailer
snippet.description:
The Legend of Darkness is a SMBX-38A episode made by Hel Studio, whose members are mostly from China.

To celebrate Mario's 40th Anniversary, I created commemorative levels based on the framework of the SMBX-38A project - 'The Legend of Darkness' that our team previously built, and integrated them into a standalone game for everyone to play. These stages blend elements from Super Mario Bros. with other classic 2D Mario games, offering a fresh yet nostalgic experience for players.

You can join our Discord server to download the demo and learn about the newest progress of this project: https://discord.gg/DwCgAKa7HQ

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/14IdJbePyM0dmFNFg_C1-eo0eOi3EvuYw/view?usp=sharing

For details, you can visit: https://smtlod.smbx.world/40th/
